info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Seatmaps-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Seatmap Retrieval API enables users to access and view seat maps for airline flights. This API allows applications to present available seating arrangements, enhancing customer experience during the booking process. Typical consumers of this API include travel agencies and airline booking platforms that require visual representations of flight seat configurations. By integrating this API, businesses can facilitate informed decisions for travelers selecting their preferred seating options.

get.summary: Retrieve the seat map for a specific flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the seat map of a flight, providing detailed information about available seats, including their status, type, and location within the aircraft.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the seat map for a specified flight. It should contain the necessary parameters to identify the flight, such as flight number and date, enabling the server to return the relevant seating arrangement.
